emma_pm: Heads up - PartnerOps (EdgeWave) requested a compact evidence bundle for marketplace listing: SOC excerpt, one-page pen attestation, and a KMS/HSM statement confirming no key export. They need something before COB Wed.

security_ops: We can provide a redacted SOC excerpt (controls + auditor), a vendor-signed pen attestation (one page) and a short KMS statement. Redaction rules: remove IPs, internal hostnames, employee PII, and any exploit detail.

partner_ops: Presigned link is preferred. Legal asked that retention be short (48-72h) and that we include an owner contact.

emma_pm: OK. @security_ops can you produce the attestation + KMS text? I'll produce presigns and manifest.

security_ops: Will do. KMS statement sample: "Redwood uses HSM-backed symmetric CMKs in AWS KMS for service encryption of model artifacts. Customer BYOK is supported via API; Redwood never exports customer-managed key material to partners." I'll include a small ascii diagram and reference to internal diagram (private link).

legal_liaison: Attestation must include vendor name and date. We have a TrustAssure attestation dated 2025-07-20 that we can redact and share.

evidence_bot: [automated] Evidence policy: required metadata - owner, TTL_hours, taxonomy tag `marketplace-evidence/v1`. Default TTL <= 72h.

emma_pm: Manifest I'll publish: artifact names, owner (emma_pm), ttl_hours=48, redaction_status. Example manifest.json inside bundle.

partner_ops: Perfect. Please DM presigned tarball and manifest when ready. I'll mark listing as pending until we receive.

security_ops: Preparing attestation now; will post for redaction review in this thread in ~90 minutes.

emma_pm: Plan: (1) security_ops posts docs, (2) I review redaction and assemble bundle, (3) create presign(s) TTL=48h, (4) drop into partner intake and DM. Target: 2025-08-27 16:00 PT.

partner_ops: Thanks — legal will confirm once uploaded. :thumbsup:
